claims.claim: Day 5: NZ 119/2 to 239/5 in 75 overs (120 runs, 1.60 an over): morning 38/2 in 26 overs, to tea 49/1 in 25, last session 33/0 in 24; India took 3 wickets (Conway 65, Rachin 37, Blundell 15)
387 dot balls of 451 on Day 5 (86%); 34 maidens in 75 overs; India's innings 42 maidens, the most by a team innings in the WTC 2025-27 cycle
Mitchell 49* (186 balls, 160 dots) and Phillips 26* (126, 111 dots): 63* in 259 balls over 43 overs (176/5 to 239/5)
43 overs: second-most for an NZ sixth-wicket-or-lower stand in the third innings of a drawn Test this century; record 123 overs, McCullum and Watling (352), Wellington 2014 v India
Mitchell's chances: run-out missed by Akash Deep (73.1, on 12), bat-pad off Prasidh with no forward short leg (88.2, on 24), Kamboj kicker, Padikkal could not hold (94.4, on 24)
Prasidh Day 5: 11-8-3-1; Washington 27-12-49-1; Bumrah 11-6-9-0; Kamboj 13-4-24-1; Akash Deep 10-4-22-0
conditions: breeze 22 km/h from the north, 16 degrees, some cloud, no rain threat; pitch dried out, grass dead, still a very good batting surface
WTC: both sides 4 points; NZ 66.67 percent, slip behind Australia to third; India 4th on 50, need to win all next 6 Tests; 16 points missed across two drawn Tests
Handshake with about an hour left (17:40 local): India had 3 wickets in 75 overs (one every 25); Nicholls 175* Player of the Match, Phillips 118 in NZ's 368
India's lines (our read, balls with a stated line and length): on or outside off 73% before lunch -> 93% lunch to tea; on middle 20% -> 3%
